string-array.item: Did you know? Catrobat is a visual programming language for creating games, stories and animations.
NeoCatroid is a fork of Catrobat/Catroid with built-in 3D support.
You can publish your own apps directly from the project options menu.
Blocks can be combined into custom procedures to keep your code tidy.
The first visual programming languages appeared back in the 1960s with Logo.
NeoCatroid can build a standalone Windows player for your project.
Sprites can talk to each other using broadcast messages.
You can add physics to your objects with just a few blocks.
Lists let you store many values under a single variable name.
Cloning sprites is a great way to create many similar enemies or particles.
Almost any value on the stage can be read by a sensor block.
You can back up your projects and restore them later from a zip file.
